title: Self-balancing robot controller (mechatronic: sense + actuate + structure)
goal: A self-balancing two-wheel robot controller: an MPU-6050 IMU on I2C for tilt sensing, dual DC motor drivers (H-bridge, PWM speed control) for the wheel motors, an ESP32 microcontroller, powered by a 2S LiPo through a 3.3 V buck regulator, on a 60 x 40 mm PCB mounted to an aluminium chassis bracket that carries the motor reaction load. Mass budget 60 g for the board.

requirements: interfaces stated (I2C tilt sense, PWM motor control)
power quantified (2S LiPo in, 3.3 V rail)
architecture: subsystems identified (sense, actuate, compute, power, structure)
design: chassis bracket / mechanical envelope authored and committed
load path for the motor reaction noted
electronics: schematic topology defined (IMU + dual H-bridge + ESP32 + buck)
components selected for THIS product (motor drivers, not just a sensor)
power budget closed under motor load
firmware: IMU read + PWM motor drive approach noted
pin map covering I2C and the motor PWM/direction pins
simulation: ERC/DRC or a design check noted
